faq.domanda: What exactly are resin domed labels?
faq.risposta: They are custom stickers coated with a raised, clear resin (which is why they are also called doming). The resin gives a three-dimensional, glossy effect and protects the artwork and logo from scratches, water and UV rays.

faq.domanda: Which surfaces can they be applied to?
faq.risposta: Almost any: plastic, glass, metal and wood. They are ideal for gadgets, products, packaging, electronics, automotive and equipment, for both indoor and outdoor use.
They are waterproof and resistant to scratches, solvents, weather and UV rays: they keep their shine and grip for years, without fading.

faq.domanda: Can I order small quantities too?
faq.risposta: Yes: we produce resin domed labels in both small runs for artisans and personal projects and in large quantities for companies. Ask us for a quote with the quantity you need.

faq.domanda: Do you handle the design too, or do I need to provide it?
faq.risposta: We can do both: if you already have the file we check it and prepare it for print, otherwise we create the artwork tailored to your logo.
